name: everyday-productivity
description: This plugin is for anyone who wants to spend less time on routine document and file work. With its skills, you can turn meeting notes or a transcript into decisions, owned action items, and open questions. You can also compare two versions of a document, convert Markdown to Word, and translate Word and PowerPoint files while keeping their formatting. To tidy up, reorganize a folder or your desktop. The skill asks for your approval before it moves any file. For learning, you can condense a research paper for your audience or build an interactive quiz from documents, web pages, or a topic. The skills work from files that you provide and from public web sources, so you don't need a connector. A professional translator hasn't reviewed the translations. Have a qualified translator review them before you use them for legal, medical, financial, or safety purposes.
